component.name: OpenRGB E1.31 Receiver Plugin
component.summary: Turn your OpenRGB setup into an E1.31 receiver

description.p: This OpenRGB plugin adds E1.31 integration, the industry-standard lighting protocol supported by a wide variety of control software and often used for sequenced light shows. Control all of your OpenRGB-supported hardware from these programs by turning your setup into an E1.31 receiver.
